scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n server,web,desktop -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w desktop"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p shared && tsc -p server && tsc -p ui && tsc -p web && tsc -p desktop
